summary: Employee QR Code Badge, Public Digital Card page, and Bank Account Management
acceptance: Migration 017: Added bank_name, bank_account_number, bank_account_name to employees table
Pure TypeScript zero-dependency QR Code generator with SVG vector output (qrcode.ts)
Employee roster shows interactive QR badge thumbnail on each row
Clicking QR badge opens zoomable accessible dialog modal matching the Avatar viewer design pattern
QR modal contains copy link, download SVG QR, and direct navigation button
Scanning QR code directs to /employee-card public digital employee business card page
Public API endpoint GET /api/public/organizations/:organizationId/employees/:employeeCode returns safe card info with bank details
Public API endpoint GET /api/public/organizations/:organizationId/employees/:employeeId/avatar streams verified avatar
EmployeeDetailDrawer profile tab displays and allows editing bank account information
Employees create modal supports optional bank information fields
100% test coverage with automated unit tests for QR generator, QR badge component, and public digital card page
Creating a new employee profile with valid personal and optional bank details succeeds; invalid profile input reports actionable validation guidance
